content.text: {"id": "mm6401a3", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Taking a supplement that included folic acid was more common among recurrence-control mothers (80%) than recurrence-case mothers (35%)."}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "35% reported taking a folic acid supplement, whereas among 10 mothers of live-born infants"}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "Six of 17 mothers with a second NTD-affected pregnancy were Hispanic"}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Reported use of a single-ingredient folic acid supplement was more common among recurrence-control mothers, 70% (seven of 10)"}]}, {"v": "stratified/adjusted", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Single-ingredient folic acid supplement use was reported among only two of 10 case and six of eight control mothers intending pregnancy."}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "case-control", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "NBDPS is a multicenter case-control study conducted to assess risk factors for selected major birth defects."}]}, {"v": "surveillance/descriptive", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "The descriptive analysis was limited to mothers who reported a previous NTD-affected pregnancy during the interview."}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "because of small numbers and the study's design, no statistical tests were performed, and recurrence risk could not be estimated."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Frequencies of several maternal characteristics and pregnancy exposures among cases and controls were considered"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "the only indicator of whether a mother might have taken high-dosage folic acid supplement was reported use of a single-ingredient folic acid supplement"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "this sample of mothers with a previous NTD-affected pregnancy should be considered a convenience sample"}], "confidence": "medium", "uncertain_fields": ["study_design", "analytic_depth"]}
